texts.title: K
texts.body:
[A] Every year, from June to September, Salalah changes completely. Monsoon winds bring light rain and cool air from the Indian Ocean. The mountains turn green.

[B] Thousands of visitors travel to Dhofar. Families from Gulf countries come to enjoy the cool weather. Hotels become very busy.

[C] The mist makes driving dangerous. Drivers must drive slowly on mountain roads. The police give safety advice.

[D] Farmers grow bananas and coconuts near the coast. Scientists collect data about the rainfall. Officials ask people to use less plastic.
